name: A Decimate button is saved as Reap (#5469)
contract: With Decimation 704193, six stacks of the Decimation counter 573289 run aura_ascension_reaper_decimation_counter::Apply (AscensionReaperRedshade.cpp:74), which grants Decimate 500523 as a temporary spell when it is not already known (addSpell(SPELL_DECIMATE, ..., temporary = true), line 81) and replaces every known Reap rank with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 85). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the counter reaches six again, so a saved Decimate button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Decimate must be saved as Reap 500357, and a button holding Reap itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: SETUP: Decimate is not otherwise known
Six stacks replace Reap with Decimate
The Decimate button is saved as Reap
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
